loginPage.forEmployeeOnly: This webpage is for [Your Company] employees only.
loginPage.mainText: During the COVID-19 crisis, all [Your Company] employees who work at a facility providing clinical care must attest to their wellness every day before entering their building. Please attest to your wellness no earlier than two hours before your shift starts and then follow instructions.
loginPage.useCredentials: Please use [Your Company] credentials to log in

surveyPage.descriptionForSelfService: Please complete this survey before beginning any shift at a [Your Company] facility. This survey will tell you whether you are eligible to work or not. It is not meant to provide clinical advice.
surveyPage.descriptionForManualMode: Enter either User Name or Employee ID to populate the rest of the name fields. If employee does not know their user ID, please fill in first and last name.
surveyPage.symptomsQuestion: Are You Experiencing Any of the Following Symptoms
surveyPage.cough: New cough (not related to chronic condition)
surveyPage.runnyNose: New nasal congestion or new runny nose (not related to seasonal allergies)
surveyPage.noSymptoms_text2: YOU ARE CLEARED FOR WORK TODAY.
surveyPage.noSymptoms_text3: By placing my initials below, I attest that my answers are accurate.
surveyPage.symptoms_text1: YOU HAVE INDICATED ONE OR MORE SYMPTOMS
surveyPage.symptoms_text2: YOU ARE NOT CLEARED FOR WORK TODAY!
surveyPage.symptoms_text3: DO NOT GO TO WORK. PLEASE CALL YOUR MANAGER AND THE OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH COVID HOTLINE
surveyPage.symptoms_text5: If you need immediate medical assistance, call your healthcare provider or dial 911
surveyPage.pressSubmit: Please press submit button to get COVID Pass
